input_messages.content:
Hi! I actually need help with a couple of things regarding my recent orders. I just moved to a new house on Elm Avenue here in Houston, and I noticed that one of my orders was sent to my old address. I’d like to update the shipping address for that order to my new place, and also have my default address changed to the new one for future orders. 

After that, I also want to talk about exchanging the tablet I just bought for the most affordable model you have, since moving has been a bit expensive. Can you help me with all of this?

Sure, my name is Sophia Martin and my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. I’d prefer if you could look up my address details in my orders, since I don’t want to share my address directly. Let me know if you need anything else to verify my account!

I’d really prefer not to share my address directly—since both addresses are on Elm Avenue and should be visible in my order history, could you please use the information from my recent orders to update the shipping address for the order that went to the old address, and set my new Elm Avenue address as the default? 

If you need help identifying the correct order, the tablet was sent to my new place, and the other order is the one that needs the address change. Let me know if you need any other details!

Yes, please go ahead and update the shipping address for order #W1092119 to my new address, and set 760 Elm Avenue, Suite 564 as my default address as well.

And yes, I’d like to see the options for exchanging my tablet for the most affordable model you have. Please let me know what’s available and what the process would be.

I’d like to exchange my current tablet for the 10-inch screen, 64GB storage, silver color model at $903.95, since that’s the most affordable option. 

If there’s a refund due to the price difference, please process it back to my Mastercard ending in 3292. Let me know what the next steps are for the exchange!

Yes, that’s correct—I’d like to proceed with the exchange and have the refund sent to my Mastercard ending in 3292. Please go ahead and start the process, and I’ll look out for the return instructions in my email. Thank you!
No, that covers everything for now. I’ll wait for the tablet to be delivered and then reach out again for the exchange. Thanks for your help with the address updates and the information!
Thank you so much! I appreciate your help. Have a great day! ###STOP###
